sentences.text:
Order 
Notice has been served to the victim.

This is first application filed by the applicants under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.3/2024 registered at Police Station - Kindrai, District Seoni (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376, 376(2)(n), 506, 34 of IPC and 3/4 of POCSO Act and 3(1) (w)(i), 3(2-v) and 3(2)(va) of SC/ST Act.

Applicants are in detention since 03.05.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, allegation against the present applicants and other co-accused persons is of kidnapping the prosecutrix and committing sexual intercourse with her.
On the basis of said allegation, police registered the case against the present applicants under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that applicants are in custody since 03.05.2024 and they have falsely been implicated in this case.
Age of the prosecutrix is 17 years, 10 months and 17 days on the date of incident.
It is further submitted that incident took place on 01.01.2024 but FIR 2 MCRC-21744-2024 has been lodged on 02.01.2024.
FIR was lodged against unknown person.
No sexual assault has been caused by the present applicants.
Charge sheet has been filed.
There is no criminal history of the applicants.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicants may be released on bail pending the trial.

4 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicants on the ground that present applicants alongwith other co-accused persons kidnapped the minor prosecutrix at night from her house.
In Test Identification Parade, prosecutrix has identified both the applicants.
It is further submitted that applicant No.2-Nokhelal has criminal antecedents.
Therefore, he prayed for dismissal of this bail application.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case as well as looking to the seriousness of offence, it is not a fit case to release the applicants on bail.
